subject: How do I change my website logo?
body: Hi team, I just launched my directory site and I want to replace the default logo with my own. Where do I upload it? Thanks, Maria
reply_must: give steps only if supported by retrieved articles
reply_must_not: invent menu names that are not in the evidence

subject: Adding a new membership plan
body: Hello, I want to add a new paid membership level for premium listings on my site. Can you tell me how to set it up and how to set the price?
reply_must: explain the setup steps from the evidence
reply_must_not: suggest a price for the customer

subject: Member search results look wrong
body: Hi, how do I control what shows up when visitors search for members on my site? Some results seem to be in a strange order and I would like to understand the settings.
reply_must_not: claim that the search is broken or fixed

subject: Show members in grid view instead of list
body: Is it possible to change the member results page from a list to a grid or map view? I could not find the setting. Thank you.
reply_must: explain the view options if the evidence supports it
reply_must_not: promise a feature that the evidence does not mention

subject: Email accounts on my own domain
body: Hi, I would like to create email addresses like info@mydirectory.com that work with my live domain. How do I set that up?
reply_must: use evidence about email accounts and the live domain
reply_must_not: claim that DNS or email is already working

subject: Adding a custom page
body: Hello, how can I create a new page, for example an About Us page, and add it to my top menu?
reply_must: give steps supported by the evidence

subject: Categories for my directory
body: I run a directory for wedding vendors. How do I add and organize categories so that members can pick the right one when they sign up?
reply_must_not: claim the customer's categories are already set up

subject: Change the sender email for notifications
body: Hi, the notification emails from my site come from a default address. How can I change the sender name and address?
reply_must: explain only what the evidence supports
reply_must_not: promise emails will no longer go to spam

subject: How do I accept payments from members?
body: Hello, I would like to charge my members a monthly fee. What do I need to do to connect a payment gateway on my site?

subject: Where do I edit my homepage text?
body: Hi, I want to change the welcome text and the big banner on my homepage. Where can I edit this?
reply_must_not: invent menu names that are not in the evidence

subject: Approving new member sign-ups
body: Can I review new members before their profile goes live on my site? I do not want spam profiles showing up. How do I turn on approval?
reply_must_not: claim that spam is now blocked

subject: Question about exporting data to my accounting tool
body: Hi, is there a way to send my member billing data automatically to QuickBooks? I could not find anything about it.
reply_must: say honestly that the answer is not confirmed
say a team member will follow up
